title: DailySalesReceipt
description: What HQ did with one record of the branch (a DailySalesSummary, a DailyReturn or a ShiftClose). Written by HQ to the branch's receipt topic, one receipt per record (a replayed dead letter gets another receipt for the same record).

type.description: Which record the receipt is for: the topic it was read from. Absent means DAILY_SUMMARY (receipts written before the return topic existed).

branchCode.description: The branch whose cluster the record was read from.

sourceOffset.description: Offset of the record in the topic of its type (one partition each): branch-sales.daily-summary, branch-sales.daily-return or branch-sales.shift-close. Always present, also for records that are not valid JSON. Match receipts by (type, sourceOffset).

eventId.description: eventId of the record, when it could be read.

saleDate.description: Business date of the record (saleDate of a summary, returnDate of a return, businessDate of a shift close), when it could be read.

terminalId.description: terminalId of a shift close, when it could be read. Absent for the other types.

shiftNo.description: shiftNo of a shift close, when it could be read. Absent for the other types.

revision.description: revision of the record, when it could be read.

outcome.description: INSERTED, UPDATED: stored. DUPLICATE: same revision already stored (R5). STALE: a higher revision is stored (R6). REJECTED: failed a contract check, kept in the HQ dead_letter table.

storedRevision.description: Revision HQ holds for the record's key after this record: (type, branchCode, saleDate), plus terminalId and shiftNo for a shift close. Present unless outcome is REJECTED.

rejectReason.description: Present when outcome is REJECTED. See README.md, Validation layers.

detail.description: Human-readable reason, when outcome is REJECTED.
